infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the laboratory on Icebreaker.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Compartment C-3 keycard (C-3) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A Paradigm Shipping keycard marked Compartment-3. It likely opens one of the restricted compartments aboard the Boreas icebreaker.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: This keycard can only be obtained once while progressing through the story chapter Boreas.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the laboratory on level 1 of Icebreaker. Note: The door can't be opened when players without the required progress in the story chapter Boreas entered the raid.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Medbag
- Loose loot (Medical supplies, Stimulants, Meds)
- 4x LEDX Skin Transilluminator in the overseeing cabin
- Boreas scientist audio tape in the overseeing cabin
